name: Blue Trail
description: Official 3.5-mile loop with blue blazes, rated more difficult. Mostly wooded and wide enough for horses, it passes historic ruins and follows the East Branch of the Brandywine Creek on the park's west edge.

name: Lakeside Accessible Loop
description: A wide paved and boardwalk loop that circles the northern lobe of the lake. Benches and shade structures sit at regular intervals, the grades stay gentle, and the boardwalk section over the narrow neck gives open water views in both directions. Built for wheelchairs, strollers and walkers, and open to bikes.

name: Lime Loop
description: Official 1.8-mile loop with lime blazes, rated more difficult. The loop branches off the Blue Trail in the northwestern part of the park and is a local favorite for mountain biking and horseback riding.

name: Mansion Trails
description: Official 0.9-mile connector with white/blue blazes, rated easiest. Stone foundations and other remnants of the village of Milford Mills, flooded when the reservoir filled, sit beside the path.

name: Park Road Trail
description: Official 0.6-mile out-and-back, rated easiest and the park's ADA route. The paved path runs from the boat-rental parking area past the warm-season grass fields to the accessible fishing pier at the East Launch.

name: Red Trail
description: Official 1.5-mile loop with red blazes, rated more difficult and open to hiking only. It is the east-side trail, running along the lake and through woods between the day-use areas and the East Launch.

name: White Trail
description: Official 4.0-mile out-and-back and the easiest hiking route on the west side. From the West Launch it follows the lakeshore, rolls through the agricultural fields and horse-barn area, and reaches the dam. Wide, largely gentle tread with a few short climbs.

name: Yellow Trail
description: Official 6.2-mile out-and-back with yellow blazes, rated most difficult. It starts at the Dorlan Mill Road parking area and threads the mountain-bike loops south and east of the dam, with steep pitches, roots and rock.
